Ordinary prose can contain *bold*, _italic_, and `monospace` spans.

Formatting can nest. For example, *bold text with _italic_ inside* renders both
spans.

A code span is literal. `foo_bar_baz` keeps its underscores. `*stars*` keeps its
stars.

A delimiter starts a span only at a word boundary. Thus, snake_case_names stays
text. Arithmetic such as 2 * 3 * 4 also stays text.

A backslash escapes a delimiter. Thus, \*this\* is not bold.

Characters that are markup in HTML are escaped during rendering: a < b && c > d.
